text_block_list.text: One day, while taking a breather after a meeting—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
—Oh.
Hehe, I'll have to line up first thing in the morning for this...
choice_data_list: You look happy. Did something happen?
You look happy. Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah—yes, um...
Since it's Valentine's season, it looks like the racetrack is handing out limited-edition chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: It's first-come, first-served, so, um... I thought I'd line up...

They have an event like that? Racetrack-exclusive,
and first-come, first-served... Sounds like something
she'd jump at. ...I'm a little curious myself.
choice_data_list: ...Mind if I come along with you?
...Mind if I come along with you?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
—!
Um, yes, I'd love to...!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "Huh~! So Chrono-chan's Valentine's gift to her Trainer is acting as a tour guide for racetrack-exclusive chocolates? Something like that?"

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Huh, was that wrong? On Valentine's,
a lot of girls do stuff like 'give something
to Trainer!' or 'do something for Trainer!', right?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
That's true. There are definitely girls putting their all into it
to express daily gratitude or share some love, you know.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... No, um...
I also wanted to give you something to say thank you, and I was hesitating over what to pick, but...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Um... I accidentally let my mind get completely consumed by the racetrack...!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah, gotcha. So that's why "what to do for Valentine's"
just completely slipped your mind.
That's so like you, Chrono-chan~!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
W-What should I do...
I-I got so caught up with the racecourse
that I haven't prepared anything at all...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, don't worry, you don't need to overthink it so much.
Giving what you want to give, what you feel like giving...
that's truly the best way♡"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: If you two can enjoy the racetrack together, that in itself is "Love"—at least, for the two of you.
The day of chocolate distribution.

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff
text_block_list.text: The line for the limited-edition chocolate handout is over here~!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes... I really hope we receive it safely...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!
It's our turn now. Yay—

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff
text_block_list.text:
“—Oh dear.
I'm sorry, this happens to be the very last one~”

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

Regrettably, it seems neither of us can have it.
In that case, we should concede it to Chrono Genesis.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Huh... B-But...!

Personally, I'm already quite satisfied just getting
to see the limited-edition chocolate with my own eyes.
And above all else—
choice_data_list: You were looking forward to it, weren't you?
You were looking forward to it, weren't you?

text_block_list.text:
Since we were already here, we decided to stay and watch the races.
I bought a racing paper from the kiosk and immediately checked today's race lineup!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes. First, regarding the upcoming race, considering the running styles of the contenders, it's likely to be a slow pace favoring front-runners—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
――Ah! No, um, that's not it...!
It's............

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"—L-Let's eat it together!
The chocolate...!!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Um, so... t-this is a Valentine's gift
from me, okay...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
You always take such good care of me, and well,
I wanted to thank you, or, um...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Since we came all this way together,
I was hoping to enjoy not just the race, but also the limited-edition chocolates with you, Trainer...

"...If you insist that much,
I'll gladly accept it.
Above all else... your feelings mean the most to me."
choice_data_list: Thanks. Don't mind if I take one, then.
Thank you. Then I'll take one.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Um, why don't we display this box
in the Trainer's office? As joint property...
I'd like to share the box with you, too...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

Afterward, we enjoyed watching the race
while sharing the limited-edition chocolates.
Both of them successfully got the limited-edition chocolates!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It's so witty and fun.
Such a lovely thing you'd only find at a racetrack...!

Trying the chocolate right away, the two of us
excitedly cheered that it was quite delicious
while watching the race together—
(WOOAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... That was a wonderful race...
...And now it's over, isn't it?
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was fun, wasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...!
It's very—

And so, I set off on the way home.
Or rather, I tried to...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
――Ah!
Oh... y-yes, um... well...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: —P-Please take this!!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Um... these are... Valentine's chocolates.
Since you always... take such good care of me.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for accompanying me to the racecourse, as well...
I am very... grateful. So—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Not just the chocolates from the racetrack...
I wanted to give you something from me as well...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! Go ahead...!

Opening the box...
there was a museum inside.

Carefully engraved onto the surface of the chocolate bar
is an illustration of the interior of the Umamusume Museum.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes, um... they're handmade.
I couldn't quite decide on what to make, though...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
We've watched so much racing history together
with you, Trainer...
So I guess it's a memory just for the two of us...
choice_data_list: It feels almost like a waste to eat it...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
No, please, don't hold back...!
Just take a big bite without a second thought...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: —...Thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(I took the plunge and prepared it...
and she was happy with it...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (...Fufu. I want to keep witnessing racing history together with you...)
